description: Upload a local file (screenshot, document, log, ...) to a Laviya task's attachments. Returns fileID, url and embedHtml; pass fileID to laviya_update_task_description or laviya_add_task_comment to show it there (images inline).

fileName.description: Name shown in Laviya. Default: the local file name.

filePath.description: Local file path (absolute, or relative to the project root). Allowed: images (png, jpg, gif, webp), pdf, txt, md, log, json, csv, xml, zip, Office files, mp4, webm, mov; max 20 MiB.

name: laviya_upload_task_file
title: Upload Task File
